Theorem
[Strong maximum principle for $\operatorname {Rm}$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0393 1. appD:D.21\group Curvature Rigidity

If a Ricci flow has nonnegative curvature operator, then for some $\delta >0$ and each $t\in (0,\delta )$, the image of $\operatorname {Rm}[g(t)]$ is a smooth subbundle of $\Lambda ^2T^*\mathcal M$ which is invariant under parallel translation and constant in time. Its fibers are Lie subalgebras of $\mathfrak {so}(n)$.
